scanWindow: Since the 2026-09-03 completed scan, plus material missed developments from the previous 48 hours
notes: Completed the 2026-09-04 editorial scan. Published one Daily Brief after NVIDIA officially confirmed its $12.93 billion agreement to acquire Hugging Face, moving a previously held Watch candidate to Must know. NVIDIA states that Hugging Face will remain open across models, frameworks, clouds, inference providers and compute platforms and that NVIDIA hardware will not be required; Reuters independently confirms the agreement. GPT-6 Astra launched on September 3 and scored highly, but was not given a second brief because AI Compass already covered the same underlying Astra development and Critical cyber threshold on the September 2 scan; the launch is treated as a continuation rather than duplicate coverage. OpenAI's Daybreak for Frontline Defenders and NVIDIA's IFA local-AI announcements scored Worth knowing but were held below today's publication priority. Hugging Face NeoMME was logged as Worth knowing but is narrower in reader impact. Minor tutorial-style Hugging Face posts and recycled acquisition commentary were skipped. Rumours, unsupported rankings and unverified pricing were excluded.
